description: This file defines the class SugarWebServiceUtilv4_1, which extends SugarWebServiceUtilv4, providing utility functions related to SugarCRM's web services, including session validation, module access checks, and relationship data retrieval.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceUtilv4_1
classes.description: A utility class extending SugarWebServiceUtilv4, providing methods for session validation, access control, and relationship data retrieval within SugarCRM.

methods.name: validate_authenticated
methods.description: Validates the session ID, initializes session if needed, checks user activity and permissions, returns true if valid.

methods.name: check_modules_access
methods.description: Checks if a user has specified access ('write' or 'read') to a given module.

methods.name: getRelationshipResults
methods.description: Retrieves related records for a given bean and relationship link, with optional filtering, ordering, offset, and limit.
